20261023200000_move_out_final_month_bill.body:
-- FINDINGS H3b (H3 sidofynd 1), owner decision 2026-10-23 "Fakturera slutmånaden": a contract ended by a manual
-- move-out is billed for its final month up to its end date, under the same rule as after a Z05 supply end.
--
-- How a manual move-out ends the contract (installed bodies, 20261002213000 and the customer lifecycle close):
--   * gridex_end_customer_supply_v1(p_end_reason 'move_out') sets the period's end_date = actual_end_date = the
--     move-out date (the LAST supplied day, no market_end_at, status 'ended') and terminates the contract through
--     gridex_record_customer_contract_event_v1('terminated', {ends_at: p_end_date, termination_reason: 'move_out'});
--   * gridex_close_customer_lifecycle_v1 sets the open period's end_date = the move-out date (inclusive, status kept)
--     and terminates the signed/active contracts the same way with termination_reason 'move_out'.
--   gridex_record_customer_contract_event_v1 writes status 'terminated', termination_reason from the metadata and
--   ended_at = coalesce(metadata ended_at, metadata ends_at::timestamptz, ...) = the move-out date.
-- So a move-out contract is 'terminated' + 'move_out' with ended_at on exactly the period's end date: the same shape
-- as the supply-end follow-up's 'supply_end' contract. The billing gate (gridex_set_metering_billing_gate), the underlay
-- store (gridex_store_billing_underlay) and the H3 pricing/export readers (gridex_read_interval_pricing_snapshot_v1,
-- gridex_persist_pricing_run, billing_export_readiness_v; 20261023199000) accepted only 'supply_end', so the final
-- month after a manual move-out was never gated, stored, priced or exported.
--
-- Rule (one change, in the one status clause the five readers share verbatim): the terminated contract's
-- termination_reason may be 'supply_end' OR 'move_out'. Everything else is unchanged and still required: the contract
-- of the billed value's/underlay's own supply period, same tenant, customer and metering point, ended_at on that
-- period's end date (UTC or Stockholm date), a billed period status ('ending'/'ended' only with an end date), the billed
-- period not before civil midnight of the start date and not after the period's end instant (market_end_at for a
-- received end at the start of its date, otherwise civil midnight after the last supplied day = after the move-out
-- date). Not included: 'supplier_switch' (the manual end's switch-away reason), cancelled/expired contracts, any
-- other termination reason, and a move-out on another date than the period's end.
--
-- Exact-needle rewrites of the installed bodies; the migration refuses (move_out_final_month_rule_source_changed) unless
-- the installed H3 status clause is present exactly once in each function (and the gate's start/end clauses and the
-- H3 readers' 20261023199000 marker are present), and the normalized clause exactly once in the view. Owner, ACL,
-- security mode, volatility and configuration (proconfig) of the four functions and owner, ACL, options and columns
-- of the view are preserved and checked.
begin;

do $h3b$
declare
  old_status constant text := $c$NOT coalesce(sp.status IN ('active','confirmed_by_grid_owner','ending','ended'),false)
   OR (sp.status IN ('ending','ended') AND coalesce(sp.actual_end_date,sp.end_date) IS NULL)
   -- H3: a contract ended by exactly this period's end still carries the period up to that end.
   OR NOT coalesce(ct.status IN ('signed','active') OR (ct.status='terminated' AND ct.termination_reason='supply_end' AND sp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND ct.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND ((ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date=sp.end_date OR (ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm')::date=sp.end_date)),false)$c$;
  new_status constant text := $c$NOT coalesce(sp.status IN ('active','confirmed_by_grid_owner','ending','ended'),false)
   OR (sp.status IN ('ending','ended') AND coalesce(sp.actual_end_date,sp.end_date) IS NULL)
   -- H3: a contract ended by exactly this period's end still carries the period up to that end.
   -- H3b (20261023200000): that end is a Z05 supply end ('supply_end') or a manual move-out on that date ('move_out').
   OR NOT coalesce(ct.status IN ('signed','active') OR (ct.status='terminated' AND ct.termination_reason IN ('supply_end','move_out') AND sp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND ct.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND ((ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date=sp.end_date OR (ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm')::date=sp.end_date)),false)$c$;
  start_clause constant text := $c$sp.start_date IS NULL OR (sp.start_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm')>n.period_start$c$;
  end_clause constant text := $c$(coalesce(sp.actual_end_date,sp.end_date) IS NOT NULL AND (CASE
     -- H1: a received market end at the start of its date is exclusive (end_date = first day not supplied).
     -- F108 M5: it ends at the market instant itself (00:00 +0100, 23:00Z in summer), as the qualified supply basis.
     WHEN sp.market_end_at IS NOT NULL AND sp.market_end_at<=(coalesce(sp.actual_end_date,sp.end_date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm')+interval '1 hour'
     THEN sp.market_end_at ELSE (coalesce(sp.actual_end_date,sp.end_date)+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm' END)<n.period_end)$c$;
  h3_marker constant text := 'H3 (20261023199000): a contract terminated by exactly this underlay''s supply end still carries its final period';
  view_old constant text := $n$((ct.status = 'terminated'::text) AND (ct.termination_reason = 'supply_end'::text) AND (sp.end_date IS NOT NULL) AND (ct.ended_at IS NOT NULL)$n$;
  view_new constant text := $n$((ct.status = 'terminated'::text) AND (ct.termination_reason = ANY (ARRAY['supply_end'::text, 'move_out'::text])) AND (sp.end_date IS NOT NULL) AND (ct.ended_at IS NOT NULL)$n$;
  f record;
  v record;
  body text;
  definition text;
  target regprocedure;
begin
  foreach target in array array[
    'public.gridex_set_metering_billing_gate(uuid,uuid,uuid,jsonb)'::regprocedure,
    'public.gridex_store_billing_underlay(uuid,jsonb,jsonb,uuid)'::regprocedure,
    'public.gridex_read_interval_pricing_snapshot_v1(uuid,uuid,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,text,text,jsonb)'::regprocedure,
    'public.gridex_persist_pricing_run(uuid,uuid,jsonb,jsonb)'::regprocedure]
  loop
    select p.oid, p.proname, to_jsonb(p) - 'prosrc' as metadata, p.prosrc, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition into strict f
    from pg_proc p where p.oid = target;
    -- The installed rule must be exactly the H3 rule (20261022150000, 20261023196000, 20261023199000), once.
    if (length(f.prosrc) - length(replace(f.prosrc, old_status, ''))) / length(old_status) <> 1
      or position(new_status in f.prosrc) <> 0
      or (f.proname = 'gridex_set_metering_billing_gate' and (position(start_clause in f.prosrc) = 0 or position(end_clause in f.prosrc) = 0))
      or (f.proname in ('gridex_read_interval_pricing_snapshot_v1', 'gridex_persist_pricing_run') and (position(h3_marker in f.prosrc) = 0
        or position(replace(start_clause, 'n.period_start', 'v_period_start') in f.prosrc) = 0
        or position(replace(end_clause, 'n.period_end', 'v_period_end') in f.prosrc) = 0))
      or (length(f.definition) - length(replace(f.definition, f.prosrc, ''))) / length(f.prosrc) <> 1 then
      raise exception 'move_out_final_month_rule_source_changed:%', target using errcode = 'P0U01';
    end if;
    body := replace(f.prosrc, old_status, new_status);
    execute replace(f.definition, f.prosrc, body);
    if (select to_jsonb(p) - 'prosrc' from pg_proc p where p.oid = f.oid) is distinct from f.metadata
      or (select p.prosrc from pg_proc p where p.oid = f.oid) is distinct from body then
      raise exception 'move_out_final_month_metadata_changed:%', target using errcode = 'P0U01';
    end if;
  end loop;

  -- billing_export_readiness_v: the same clause, as pg_get_viewdef renders the 20261023199000 view.
  select c.oid, c.relowner, c.relacl, c.reloptions, pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) as definition,
    (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.attname, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod)) order by a.attnum)
       from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid = c.oid and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped) as columns
    into strict v
  from pg_class c where c.oid = 'public.billing_export_readiness_v'::regclass and c.relkind = 'v';
  if (length(v.definition) - length(replace(v.definition, view_old, ''))) / length(view_old) <> 1
    or position(view_new in v.definition) <> 0
    or position('exact_signed_contract_missing' in v.definition) = 0
    or position('JOIN pricing_runs n ON' in v.definition) = 0
    or position('LEFT JOIN customer_contracts c ON' in v.definition) = 0 then
    raise exception 'move_out_final_month_rule_source_changed:billing_export_readiness_v' using errcode = 'P0U01';
  end if;
  definition := regexp_replace(replace(v.definition, view_old, view_new), ';\s*$', '');
  execute format('create or replace view public.billing_export_readiness_v%s as %s',
    case when v.reloptions is null then '' else ' with (' || array_to_string(v.reloptions, ', ') || ')' end, definition);
  if (select row(c.relowner, c.relacl, c.reloptions) from pg_class c where c.oid = v.oid) is distinct from row(v.relowner, v.relacl, v.reloptions)
    or (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.attname, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod)) order by a.attnum)
          from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid = v.oid and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped) is distinct from v.columns
    or position(view_new in pg_get_viewdef(v.oid)) = 0 then
    raise exception 'move_out_final_month_metadata_changed:billing_export_readiness_v' using errcode = 'P0U01';
  end if;
end
$h3b$;

commit;

20261023201000_manual_end_shortens_ediel.body:
-- FINDINGS H3c (H3 sidofynd 1), owner decision 2026-10-23 "Ediel-start + manuellt slut": the START of a supply period
-- is qualified by the received Ediel normal switch (Z04, normal_switch_confirmations + normal_supply_activations); a
-- manual end (the customer reported a move-out or termination by e-mail/phone and the operator ended the supply in the
-- platform) may SHORTEN that period, never extend it, and the days up to and including the move-out day are billed.
-- A later Z05 from the grid owner corrects the period through the existing Z05 flow (a new received state).
--
-- Defect: the billing gate, the underlay store and the underlay binding read gridex_received_sources.billing_supply_basis_v1
-- -> supply_period_source_basis_v1, which for a normal-switch period returned NULL after a manual end, also for days
-- BEFORE the move-out (*_qualified_supply_source_required), because
--   (1) the period row had to equal the received state (activation.resulting_period / the transition's resulting
--       state) in every field except updated_at/status, and the manual end changes fields of that row; and
--   (2) the carrying contract had to be signed/active or terminated 'supply_end', and the manual end terminates it
--       with 'move_out'.
--
-- What the manual end writers change on the period row (installed bodies, read from the world database):
--   * gridex_close_customer_lifecycle_v1(p_mode 'move_out'|'terminate', p_move_out_date) on an active/confirmed period:
--     end_date = the move-out date (the LAST supplied day), metadata || {planned_end_source:'customer_lifecycle_close',
--     planned_end_reason: p_mode, planned_end_recorded_at}, updated_at. Status, actual_end_date and everything else kept.
--   * gridex_end_customer_supply_v1(p_end_reason 'move_out', p_source_message_id NULL) on an active/confirmed period:
--     end_date = actual_end_date = the move-out date, status 'ended', metadata || {end_reason:'move_out',
--     end_key: '<metering_point_id>:<end date>', ended_by_grid_owner_at}, updated_at (source_message_id kept).
--   Both terminate the contract through gridex_record_customer_contract_event_v1: status 'terminated',
--   termination_reason 'move_out', ended_at = the move-out date (production_contract_hash_v1 excludes these fields).
--
-- Rule (two exact-text changes in supply_period_source_basis_v1, nothing else):
--   (a) the received-state equality still applies, unless the row is the received state shortened by exactly such a
--       manual end: every field except updated_at/status/end_date/actual_end_date/metadata equals the received state;
--       the received status is 'active'/'confirmed_by_grid_owner'; start_date <= end_date <= the received end_date (if
--       any); the metadata equals the received metadata apart from the six manual-end keys; a new, complete
--       lifecycle-close marker (status and actual_end_date kept) and/or a new, complete end-supply 'move_out' marker
--       whose end_key is this period's metering point and end date (status 'ended', actual_end_date = end_date); and
--       the queried interval ends no later than civil midnight after the move-out day. market_start_at, market_end_at
--       (so the existing p_end<=market_end_at bound), market_state_version, source ids, customer, metering point,
--       contract and tenant stay received. Not accepted: an extension, an end before the start, another tenant/customer/
--       point/contract, a 'supplier_switch' or source-message end, a bare end_date edit without a manual-end marker, a

      continue when not found or coalesce(v_review_contract.binding_months, 0) <= 0;
      v_binding_start := coalesce(v_review_contract.actual_start_at, v_review_contract.confirmed_start_at,
        (select min(coalesce(sp.actual_start_date, sp.start_date)) from public.customer_supply_periods sp
          where sp.company_id = p_company_id and sp.customer_id = p_customer_id
            and coalesce(sp.customer_contract_id, sp.contract_id) = v_review_contract_id
            and sp.status in ('active', 'confirmed_by_grid_owner', 'ending', 'ended')),
        v_review_contract.starts_at, v_review_contract.expected_start_at);
      v_binding_end := (v_binding_start + make_interval(months => v_review_contract.binding_months))::date;
      continue when v_binding_end is null or v_binding_end <= p_move_out_date + 1;
      v_review_contract_ids := v_review_contract_ids || v_review_contract_id;
      continue when exists (
        select 1 from public.customer_operation_tasks t
        where t.company_id = p_company_id and t.task_type = 'break_fee_review'
          and t.metadata->>'contract_id' = v_review_contract_id::text);
      insert into public.customer_operation_tasks (
        company_id, customer_id, metering_point_id, task_type, status, priority,
        title, description, metadata, created_by, updated_by
      ) values (
        p_company_id, p_customer_id, v_review_contract.metering_point_id, 'break_fee_review', 'open', 'normal',
        'Bedöm brytavgift vid flytt',
        'Kunden flyttade före bindningstidens slut. Bedöm om och vilken brytavgift avtalet medger. Inget debiteras automatiskt.',
        jsonb_build_object(
          'contract_id', v_review_contract_id,
          'binding_months', v_review_contract.binding_months,
          'binding_starts_at', v_binding_start,
          'binding_ends_at', v_binding_end,
          'supply_end_date', p_move_out_date,
          'first_unsupplied_date', p_move_out_date + 1,
          'end_reason', 'move_out',
          'end_key', 'customer-lifecycle-close:' || p_customer_id::text || ':' || v_review_contract_id::text,
          'customer_type', v_before.customer_type,
          'charged_automatically', false
        ),
        p_actor_user_id, p_actor_user_id
      );
    end loop;
  end if;$n4$,
$n5$    'lifecycle', v_metadata,
    'final_invoice_tasks', v_final_invoice_tasks,
    'break_fee_review_contract_ids', to_jsonb(v_review_contract_ids)
  );$n5$]);

20261023203000_h3d_contract_end_after_su.body:
-- FINDINGS H3d D8 (reports/h3d-move-out-notice.md), owner decisions 2026-10-23 B1, B3 and 20 (OWNER-DECISIONS.md rows
-- 16, 18 and 20): at a move-out the CONTRACT ends by its notice period, while the SUPPLY (and all energy and fixed-fee
-- billing) ends at the actual supply end (the move-out day, an ended grid contract, the grid owner's end). The contract
-- end may therefore lie AFTER the supply end. Nothing is ever billed after the supply end.
--
-- Defect: the shared H3/H3b rule (gridex_set_metering_billing_gate, gridex_store_billing_underlay,
-- gridex_read_interval_pricing_snapshot_v1, gridex_persist_pricing_run, billing_export_readiness_v; 20261023199000,
-- 20261023200000) required the terminated contract's ended_at to fall ON the period's end date (as does the H3c qualified
-- supply basis, changed by 20261023203500). A contract that runs on through its notice period after the move-out
-- (ended_at > end_date) was refused for the whole final month, also for the supplied days. The manual close's 'terminate' mode wrote 'move_out' (D9); the H3d termination slice
-- (20261023205000) writes the actual reason instead: 'customer_termination' (a termination without ongoing supply) and
-- 'grid_contract_ended' (the customer's grid contract ended, so there is no supply although the notice runs on).
--
-- Rule (one change in the status clause the five readers share verbatim):
--   a terminated contract carries its own supply period when termination_reason is 'supply_end', 'move_out',
--   'grid_contract_ended' or 'customer_termination' and ended_at (UTC or Stockholm date) is ON OR AFTER the period's end
--   date. Everything else is unchanged and still required: the contract of the billed period's own supply period (same
--   tenant, customer and metering point), a billed period status, and the billed period inside the supplied window
--   (not before civil midnight of the start date, not after the period's end instant: the received market end, or civil
--   midnight after the last supplied day). So the supplied days are billed and nothing after the supply end, however
--   long the notice runs. Still refused: 'supplier_switch', 'customer_request', any other or no reason, a contract
--   ended BEFORE its period's end date, cancelled/expired contracts, another tenant/contract, and an open period (the
--   rule requires an end date).
-- The same rule in the qualified supply basis is 20261023203500.
--
-- Exact-needle rewrites; the migration refuses (h3d_contract_end_after_supply_rule_source_changed) unless every needle
-- is present exactly once and the replacement is absent. Owner, ACL, security mode, volatility and configuration
-- (proconfig) of the four functions and the owner, ACL, options and columns of the view are preserved and checked.
begin;

do $h3d8$
declare
  old_status constant text := $c$NOT coalesce(sp.status IN ('active','confirmed_by_grid_owner','ending','ended'),false)
   OR (sp.status IN ('ending','ended') AND coalesce(sp.actual_end_date,sp.end_date) IS NULL)
   -- H3: a contract ended by exactly this period's end still carries the period up to that end.
   -- H3b (20261023200000): that end is a Z05 supply end ('supply_end') or a manual move-out on that date ('move_out').
   OR NOT coalesce(ct.status IN ('signed','active') OR (ct.status='terminated' AND ct.termination_reason IN ('supply_end','move_out') AND sp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND ct.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND ((ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date=sp.end_date OR (ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm')::date=sp.end_date)),false)$c$;
  new_status constant text := $c$NOT coalesce(sp.status IN ('active','confirmed_by_grid_owner','ending','ended'),false)
   OR (sp.status IN ('ending','ended') AND coalesce(sp.actual_end_date,sp.end_date) IS NULL)
   -- H3: a contract ended by exactly this period's end still carries the period up to that end.
   -- H3b (20261023200000): that end is a Z05 supply end ('supply_end') or a manual move-out on that date ('move_out').
   -- H3d D8 (20261023203000): the contract may end on or AFTER the supply end (its notice period runs on, owner decision
   -- B1); it carries only the supplied days (the end clause bounds the billed period by the supply end). Manual ends:
   -- 'move_out', 'grid_contract_ended' and 'customer_termination' (a termination without ongoing supply).
   OR NOT coalesce(ct.status IN ('signed','active') OR (ct.status='terminated' AND ct.termination_reason IN ('supply_end','move_out','grid_contract_ended','customer_termination') AND sp.end_date IS NOT NULL AND ct.ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND ((ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date>=sp.end_date OR (ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm')::date>=sp.end_date)),false)$c$;
  start_clause constant text := $c$sp.start_date IS NULL OR (sp.start_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm')>n.period_start$c$;
  end_clause constant text := $c$(coalesce(sp.actual_end_date,sp.end_date) IS NOT NULL AND (CASE
     -- H1: a received market end at the start of its date is exclusive (end_date = first day not supplied).
     -- F108 M5: it ends at the market instant itself (00:00 +0100, 23:00Z in summer), as the qualified supply basis.
     WHEN sp.market_end_at IS NOT NULL AND sp.market_end_at<=(coalesce(sp.actual_end_date,sp.end_date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm')+interval '1 hour'
     THEN sp.market_end_at ELSE (coalesce(sp.actual_end_date,sp.end_date)+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm' END)<n.period_end)$c$;
  h3_marker constant text := 'H3 (20261023199000): a contract terminated by exactly this underlay''s supply end still carries its final period';
  view_old constant text := $n$((ct.status = 'terminated'::text) AND (ct.termination_reason = ANY (ARRAY['supply_end'::text, 'move_out'::text])) AND (sp.end_date IS NOT NULL) AND (ct.ended_at IS NOT NULL) AND ((((ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text))::date = sp.end_date) OR (((ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm'::text))::date = sp.end_date)))$n$;
  view_new constant text := $n$((ct.status = 'terminated'::text) AND (ct.termination_reason = ANY (ARRAY['supply_end'::text, 'move_out'::text, 'grid_contract_ended'::text, 'customer_termination'::text])) AND (sp.end_date IS NOT NULL) AND (ct.ended_at IS NOT NULL) AND ((((ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'::text))::date >= sp.end_date) OR (((ct.ended_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Stockholm'::text))::date >= sp.end_date)))$n$;
  f record;
  v record;
  body text;
  definition text;
  target regprocedure;
begin
  foreach target in array array[
    'public.gridex_set_metering_billing_gate(uuid,uuid,uuid,jsonb)'::regprocedure,
    'public.gridex_store_billing_underlay(uuid,jsonb,jsonb,uuid)'::regprocedure,
    'public.gridex_read_interval_pricing_snapshot_v1(uuid,uuid,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,text,text,jsonb)'::regprocedure,
    'public.gridex_persist_pricing_run(uuid,uuid,jsonb,jsonb)'::regprocedure]
  loop
    select p.oid, p.proname, to_jsonb(p) - 'prosrc' as metadata, p.prosrc, pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition into strict f
    from pg_proc p where p.oid = target;
    -- The installed rule must be exactly the H3b rule (20261023200000), once.
    if (length(f.prosrc) - length(replace(f.prosrc, old_status, ''))) / length(old_status) <> 1
      or position(new_status in f.prosrc) <> 0
      or position('H3d D8 (20261023203000)' in f.prosrc) <> 0
      or (f.proname = 'gridex_set_metering_billing_gate' and (position(start_clause in f.prosrc) = 0 or position(end_clause in f.prosrc) = 0))
      or (f.proname in ('gridex_read_interval_pricing_snapshot_v1', 'gridex_persist_pricing_run') and (position(h3_marker in f.prosrc) = 0
        or position(replace(start_clause, 'n.period_start', 'v_period_start') in f.prosrc) = 0
        or position(replace(end_clause, 'n.period_end', 'v_period_end') in f.prosrc) = 0))
      or (length(f.definition) - length(replace(f.definition, f.prosrc, ''))) / length(f.prosrc) <> 1 then
      raise exception 'h3d_contract_end_after_supply_rule_source_changed:%', target using errcode = 'P0U01';
    end if;
    body := replace(f.prosrc, old_status, new_status);
    execute replace(f.definition, f.prosrc, body);
    if (select to_jsonb(p) - 'prosrc' from pg_proc p where p.oid = f.oid) is distinct from f.metadata
      or (select p.prosrc from pg_proc p where p.oid = f.oid) is distinct from body then
      raise exception 'h3d_contract_end_after_supply_metadata_changed:%', target using errcode = 'P0U01';
    end if;
  end loop;

  -- billing_export_readiness_v: the same clause, as pg_get_viewdef renders the 20261023200000 view.
  select c.oid, c.relowner, c.relacl, c.reloptions, pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) as definition,
    (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.attname, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod)) order by a.attnum)
       from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid = c.oid and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped) as columns
    into strict v
  from pg_class c where c.oid = 'public.billing_export_readiness_v'::regclass and c.relkind = 'v';
  if (length(v.definition) - length(replace(v.definition, view_old, ''))) / length(view_old) <> 1
    or position(view_new in v.definition) <> 0
    or position('exact_signed_contract_missing' in v.definition) = 0
    or position('JOIN pricing_runs n ON' in v.definition) = 0
    or position('LEFT JOIN customer_contracts c ON' in v.definition) = 0 then
    raise exception 'h3d_contract_end_after_supply_rule_source_changed:billing_export_readiness_v' using errcode = 'P0U01';
  end if;
  definition := regexp_replace(replace(v.definition, view_old, view_new), ';\s*$', '');
  execute format('create or replace view public.billing_export_readiness_v%s as %s',
    case when v.reloptions is null then '' else ' with (' || array_to_string(v.reloptions, ', ') || ')' end, definition);
  if (select row(c.relowner, c.relacl, c.reloptions) from pg_class c where c.oid = v.oid) is distinct from row(v.relowner, v.relacl, v.reloptions)
    or (select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(a.attname, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod)) order by a.attnum)
          from pg_attribute a where a.attrelid = v.oid and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped) is distinct from v.columns
    or position(view_new in pg_get_viewdef(v.oid)) = 0 then
    raise exception 'h3d_contract_end_after_supply_metadata_changed:billing_export_readiness_v' using errcode = 'P0U01';
  end if;
end
$h3d8$;

commit;
